title: สมดุลคือกระบวนการ ไม่ใช่จุดหมายปลายทาง
idea: For students abroad, study, part-time work and life never split the same way two weeks running. Some weeks are all study, some are mostly life. Balance is something you keep adjusting, not a place you arrive.
